student_entry_prompt: Help me work through Module 2 alongside the course. Use the course guide, find where I am up to and help me understand and complete the next step using my own business.
principle: Student studies the course; Jarvis explains and helps execute. Study status and work status are separate.

lessons.title: The Irresistible Offer

sections.title: What is the problem costing them?
What does the buyer already understand?

lessons.student_studies: Read the explanation of an offer, the cost of the problem and buyer awareness.
lessons.jarvis_helps: Explain any confusing section with their niche as the example. Do not start researching a niche unless they request it.

lessons.title: AI services you can sell
lessons.student_studies: Read the service descriptions and client-specific variants for the options that interest them.
lessons.jarvis_helps: Compare relevant services and explain workflow, human handoffs and realistic delivery.

lessons.title: Choose Your Niche
lessons.student_studies: Read how service and niche fit together and browse relevant niche groups.
lessons.jarvis_helps: Use background, interests and location to compare up to three combinations; preserve an existing niche or service choice.

lessons.title: What an Irresistible Offer Looks Like

sections.title: Where do you use your offer?

lessons.student_studies: Read the six-line roofing example, why the owner would want it and where it is used.
lessons.jarvis_helps: Explain result vs mechanism, result timing vs setup and approved vs proposed remedies. The example is not the student’s default offer.

lessons.title: Create Your Offer
lessons.student_studies: Read each practical step, then do it with Jarvis.
lessons.jarvis_helps: Choose buyer; research problem and value; define service and delivery; invoke six-line offer skill; review with student and save.

finish_line: Student can explain who buys, the problem and its estimated financial consequence.
Student understands what the service does, its limits, human involvement and delivery route.
Student has chosen a niche/service and reviewed their six-line offer.
Approved or explicitly proposed offer is saved for the landing-page skill.
runtime_status: Instruction and content handoff only. Target Jarvis 2.0 retrieval, tools, persistence and learner journey require validation.
